headline: Every block of cheese checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
visitLine: Call and visit to your site
heroLede: With several dairy plants across Victoria and many cheeses in similar packs, the seal, the label and the date have to be right on every block at every site. Here's what a camera check could look like on your cheese packing line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every block is sealed tight, with no open seals, loose film or torn corners. A seal that lets air in means mould on the shelf and a complaint from the store.
labelLede: A tasty block and a light block look the same in the pack, and the wrong label is a wrong fat claim. The camera checks every block carries the right label for the cheese inside, straight and intact.
codeLede: The best-before and batch code has to be right and readable on every block. The system reads the printed code and compares it with the cheese and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Film offcuts, glove pieces and loose parts can end up close to the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a carton.

vocab.alert: Four open seals in fifteen minutes. Check the vacuum sealer.
